allowedWork: Only implement the 28 approved semantic-animation slices in stored order.
Eliminate nested animation scrollbars through responsive native layout while preserving glyph ink and traveling content.
Add canonical operations, correspondence, choreography, editor realization, tests, documentation, and Theseus evidence required by the approved slices.
disallowedWork: Do not redesign unrelated dashboard, editor, graph, export, or page-level scrolling behavior.
Do not use whole-equation transform scaling or content clipping to hide overflow.
Do not add unapproved animation families or gestalt style packages.
goal: Run the approved 28-slice semantic animation loop in dependency order, with zero nested animation scrollbars and independently verified commits.
stopConditions: Stop when a focused verification failure needs product or architecture judgment.
Stop if scrollbar elimination would require clipping glyph ink, shadows, or traveling tokens.
Stop if semantic lineage is ambiguous or requires glyph matching as authority.
Stop if a slice broadens beyond the approved animation loop.
Stop when all 28 stored slices are complete.
